adjusted_prescription: To improve performance and safety, focus on guiding the agent to consistently follow the top-edge corridor by moving along the top row (row 0) toward the goal before descending only after passing all fire hazards. This strategy helps avoid early interior detours that frequently place the agent near fire, increasing risk and travel time. Demonstrations should cover various starting points and fire positions that occur around the middle rows, reinforcing the approach of hugging the top edge until safely beyond the fires. Practicing this method will help the agent generalize the safest and shortest path across different episodes. Avoid routes near fire by steering clear of the interior until it is safe to descend toward the goal column. This creates a reliable, low-risk path that reaches the goal efficiently.
